messages:
noah: FYI kicking off config-only change during the 02:00-02:40 PT window. goal: tighten routing ceilings and shorten timeouts to reduce long-tail cost. changes: tenant_max=12 -> 8, request_timeout 65s -> 40s, batch_window 14ms -> 7ms, add routing split for spillover. small staged canary: 1% -> 8% -> 100%. notes: https://go/release/2026-03-surge-safety
release-manager: copy. attach preflight doc please and set abort thresholds: p95 +18% OR 5xx_rate >0.4% sustained 2m. also include quick rollback command and pinned fallback route policy (route:stable-legacy).
tara: will post preflight checklist in thread. can we split canary across AZs and across two instance classes to avoid instance-type bias?
noah: yes, will distribute across AZs and t2,t3 instance groups. I'll also pin fallback policy.route=stable-legacy before canary starts.
deploybot: deploybot: queued release "surge-safety-config-2026-03" by noah. pipeline: validate -> canary(1%) -> wait(8m) -> canary(8%) -> wait(12m) -> ramp(100%). running preflight smoke.
deploybot: preflight smoke: ok (auth, basic-gen, embed sanity)
sre-oncall: monitoring set: p95_latency, 5xx_rate, kv_cache_miss_rate, mem_tot, cpu_load, tenant_error_rate. alert if 5xx_rate >0.4% for 2m OR p95 > baseline*1.18. Pager if tenant_error_rate spike >1% for any tenant.
ops-bot: runbook checklist: 1) warm_kv_cache for top tenants, 2) pin fallback route route:stable-legacy, 3) prepare soft-throttle cmds, 4) have rollback traffic cmd ready.
tara: config snippet to apply:
```json
{
  "tenant_max": 8,
  "request_timeout_s": 40,
  "batch_window_ms": 7,
  "routing_spillover": {"spill_threshold": 0.98, "spill_policy": "spill-to-default"}
}
```
noah: starting warm_kv_cache now for tenants H,I,J.
deploybot: canary(1%) started at 02:05:03 PT. distributing across AZs and instance groups. monitoring.
sre-oncall: initial: p50 down slightly, p95 flat, kv_cache_miss +9% (expected). no 5xx.
noah: 1% held for 8m. moving to 8% at 02:13:15 PT.
deploybot: canary(8%) in progress.
sre-oncall: at 8% seeing a 0.7% 5xx spike concentrated on tenant K. per-tenant error rate for K = 3.2%. rolling back K from canary and adding to exclude list.
tara: applying `tenant-exclude K` now. also enabling fallback route for traffic from K to stable-legacy.
deploybot: tenant-exclude K applied. route flip for K -> route:stable-legacy applied.
release-manager: decision: pause at 8% until we confirm K is stable on fallback. if system-wide 5xx goes above 0.4% for 2m, auto-fallback to route:stable-legacy global.
sre-oncall: keeping watch. K appears to have malformed batched requests that hit a thin path. ops: please capture logs for tenant K and inform customer success if needed.
noah: capturing logs and opening a follow-up; also running a temporary soft-throttle change for K's shard: batch_window 7->4 and tenant_max 8->6 for K only.
ops-bot: soft-throttle applied for tenant K. monitor 5m.
sre-oncall: after soft-throttle, tenant K 5xx back down to 0.4% and then 0.2%. system 5xx now under threshold. p95 improved slightly.
deploybot: canary(8%) held for 12m and passes gates. preparing ramp to 100% at 02:27:40 PT.
tara: small ops note: prepare `rb traffic set --policy route:stable-legacy --all` in case of immediate rollback. keep it in clipboard.
noah: ramp started. distributing across AZs and instances.
sre-oncall: post-ramp quick-check: p95 -9% vs baseline, 5xx stable 0.15%. cost-per-token trending down.
release-manager: tagging config commit cfg@f9e8d7 and updating release notes with the tenant-exclude and soft-throttle mitigation steps.
tara: updating runbook: add tenant-specific soft-throttle move and exclude flow, and note that tenant K needs a follow-up with platform support to investigate batching behavior.
ops-bot: perf-snapshot saved to perf-archive/surge-safety/2026-03. alerts cleared.
noah: closing window early at 02:34 PT. final note: post-deploy writeup will include timelines, tenant K root cause investigation pointer, and cost numbers.
release-manager: great job. marking release status: success. will publish post-deploy summary tomorrow AM. :white_check_mark:
